headline: Strategy skipped its weekly bitcoin purchase to buy back its own preferred shares, while bitcoin holds near $80,000 ahead of Wednesday's Fed decision.

stories.title: Strategy skips its weekly bitcoin buy and spends $205M buying back its own preferred shares
stories.summary: Strategy bought no bitcoin last week. Its Monday filing shows it spent about $205M buying back its STRC preferred shares instead. The pause came after bitcoin fell toward $80,000 last week.
points: Strategy bought no BTC and sold no common stock for the week; it repurchased 2.07M STRC preferred shares for $204.9M, per Cointelegraph.
Holdings are unchanged at 848,517 BTC, bought for $64.02B at an average of $75,446 per bitcoin, per Cointelegraph.
In October so far it has spent about $664M on STRC buybacks versus $72.3M on 851 BTC, per Cointelegraph.
MSTR shares were trading around $141-143 premarket on 26 Oct after closing at $146.01 on 23 Oct, per The Crypto Times.
Strategy reports third-quarter earnings after the US close on Thursday 29 Oct, per The Crypto Times.

sources.label: Cointelegraph: Strategy skips BTC buy for $205M STRC buyback

stories.title: Bitcoin stuck near $80,000 into Fed week as ETFs log two days of outflows
stories.summary: Bitcoin dipped below $80,000 again on Monday and bounced back. Money left the US spot bitcoin funds on both Thursday and Friday, and markets expect the Fed to hold rates on Wednesday but raise them in December.
points: Bitcoin dipped to about $79,330 and recovered to roughly $80,250, down about 2.5% on the week and about 36% below its $126,080 all-time high, per Decrypt.
Spot bitcoin ETFs (funds that hold bitcoin for stock-market investors) saw net outflows of $635.5M on 22 Oct and $137.94M on 23 Oct, per SoSoValue data reported by Bloomingbit.
CME FedWatch prices about a 90% chance of no change on Wednesday and about 80% for a December hike, per CoinDesk.
US crude fell about 2% to near $101 and Brent to around $110 as mediators met in Tehran, per CoinDesk; forced selling of leveraged crypto bets fell 71% to $153M in 24 hours.
About $10.9B of bitcoin options expire Friday at 08:00 UTC, per Yahoo Finance.

stories.title: Wallet security alerts: Keystone breach and an Electrum bug
stories.summary: Two wallet makers disclosed security problems. Keystone, a hardware wallet maker, says hackers took customer records and the key it uses to prove its devices are genuine, so it will destroy unsold stock. Separately, the Electrum bitcoin wallet fixed a bug that let rogue servers redirect coins. If you use either, follow the makers' guidance and check addresses before you sign.
points: Keystone says hackers got in on 20 Oct through a third-party tool and took 25,964 customer records plus its device authentication key, per crypto.news.
Keystone will destroy 18,835 devices in inventory and says recovery phrases and private keys were not exposed, per crypto.news.
Electrum released version 4.8.3 on 24 Oct to fix the bug; earlier versions remain vulnerable when connected to malicious servers, per CoinDesk.
Electrum users who connect only to trusted servers, including their own, were not exposed, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: Galaxy says the bitcoin bear market is over
briefs.summary: Galaxy Research says the bear market ended in June, noting five straight weekly closes above the 50-week average; it says the view is challenged by a weekly close below $76,540 that is not recovered within a month, per The Block.

briefs.title: X100 loses about $4.85M in a governance attack
briefs.summary: On 24 Oct an attacker used a flash loan (borrowed and repaid in one transaction) to take over X100's governance and drain its treasury, per CCN.

briefs.title: A $68M bet on bitcoin reaching $90,000 after the midterms
briefs.summary: One wallet bought 800 bitcoin call options at a $90,000 strike expiring 6 Nov, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: Aviva puts a money market fund share class on the XRP Ledger
briefs.summary: Aviva Investors and Ripple launched a tokenized share class of Aviva's sterling money market fund, with Aviva putting in £50M, per The Block.

briefs.title: South Korea weighs a fourth delay to its crypto tax
briefs.summary: The tax, due 1 Jan 2027, could be pushed to 1 Jan 2029; it would charge 22% on gains above ₩2.5M, per The Block.

briefs.title: CoinDCX confirms a $16M loss
briefs.summary: The Indian exchange lost 15.99M USDT from retired deposit wallets days after its CEO called breach reports a false alarm, and says the company absorbed the loss, per The Block.

briefs.title: Solana trading bot Bloom loses about $954K of user SOL
briefs.summary: About 9,408 SOL left 49 user wallets of the Telegram trading bot; Bloom called it a possible third-party compromise and pledged to reimburse users, per Startup Fortune. The cause is not confirmed.

briefs.title: Ethereum's Glamsterdam test is still on hold
briefs.summary: The Hoodi test-network run of Ethereum's next upgrade, which had been set for 26 Oct, is postponed with no new date, per Bitcoin Sistemi.
